channel.description: Layer Animation Group Animation group animation and layer animation to member of a group works together. for instance, you can create a rotation animation to a layer as member of a group, and create a linear animation to a group which moves the group position Animation to a layer for instance a red triagnle will rotate 720 degree. To x, y: nil roation: 720 scale: 0.2 Animation to a group group0 position will move to (200, 0)
